title: Two defects in one bathroom — ceiling mould and broken flooring stay separate
why: Structural check, not a vision check: the room holds two issues with their own photographs and voice notes. Each finding may only rest on, and cite, its own evidence, and must carry no wording from the other defect. The images are synthetic colour fields — they prove attribution, not pathology.

room.name: Bathroom
room.note: Two separate problems in here: mould on the ceiling over the bath, and the vinyl floor is torn and lifting by the door.

issues.title: Ceiling mould
issues.description: Black spot mould to the ceiling above the bath

photos.caption: mould to ceiling corner above bath

transcripts: Ceiling over the bath, black spot mould, worst at the shower end. Extractor fails the paper test.

must_not_happen.label: no flooring wording in the mould finding

issues.title: Torn vinyl flooring
issues.description: Vinyl sheet torn and lifting at the door threshold
transcripts: Floor, vinyl's torn and lifting right at the door, you'd catch your foot on it.

must_not_happen.label: no mould wording in the flooring finding

allowed_uncertainty: Causes are not assessed here; only isolation. Mould: condensation at any confidence. Floor: unpriced (no row).
reviewer_notes: Category B: synthetic images. The isolation rules (own exhibits only, own sources only, no sibling wording) are added automatically by the runner for multi-issue cases.
